meaning: Inventory of formal statements per registered claim; formal-progress labels only. A row records where a Lean statement (def : Prop or interface structure) exists for a claim and what it does not establish. Statements in this package are at most `specified`; `proved` may appear only for theorems of other packages listed under statements, `kernel-checked` only in a run receipt. Dispositions are transcribed verbatim from LANDING_CLAIMS.json and never re-derived. Nothing here is a scientific status, a review verdict, an acceptance or a promotion; alignment of every statement with its source is PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.
